comment: Completed 1B steps on nibi H100 3g.40gb. Very long episodes (2337) but low return — agent survives but doesn't progress
Completed 1B steps on nibi H100 3g.40gb. Long episodes but no dungeon entry
200M pilot on fir H100 3g.40gb. TERRIBLE: avg_return=9.06 at 200M vs PPO baseline ~9.1 at 10M. 0% dungeon entry. Combined gamma=0.999 + reward shaping severely hurts learning speed.

200M pilot on rorqual H100. avg_return=16.46 at 200M with 0% dungeon entry. Longer episodes (804) than baseline — agent masters overworld survival/combat. gamma=0.999 helps long-term but may be too slow for 200M. Needs 1B run.

200M pilot on nibi H100. TERRIBLE: avg_return=6.42 at 200M with 0% dungeon entry. WORSE than PPO baseline at 10M (9.1). Reward shaping alone is actively harmful — agent exploits easy bonuses while neglecting progression.

200M pilot on fir H100. avg_return~24.2 (running avg) / 21.9 (raw). 21% episodes >30 return. 3% >40. Max 47.1. Wider arch (1024/3L/ReLU/LN) tracks similar to baseline PPO at 200M — no dramatic improvement. Wall 8240s (2.3h).

200M pilot on rorqual H100 3g.40gb. GTrXL 512h/3L/64mem. avg_reward=20.1 (running avg). Still climbing at 200M. Max 42.1. 3.6% episodes >30. SPS=15748 (2.5x slower than PPO). Wall 14176s (3.9h). No gamma=0.999 — uses default 0.99.

200M pilot on fir H100 3g.40gb. Reference config 256h/2L/128mem/gamma=0.999/ent=0.002. avg_return=15.66 at 200M — slower start due to gamma=0.999 (expected). 0% dungeon entry. Published ref gets 41.4 at 1B. Wall 7080s (2.0h). SPS≈28248.
200M pilot on fir H100 3g.40gb. Entropy anneal 0.01→0.002. avg_return=16.06 — marginal improvement over h007 (15.66) at 200M. 0% dungeon. May help more at 1B. Wall 6842s (1.9h).

200M pilot on fir H100 3g.40gb. Structured obs encoder. avg_return=16.14 with MUCH LONGER episodes (843 vs 455 for h007). CNN preserves spatial info — zombie kills 72% vs 4%. Agent survives 2x longer. Very promising for 1B. Wall 7451s (2.1h).
200M pilot on nibi H100. Second replica of reference config. avg_return=15.50 avg_length=594.76. Consistent with fir result (15.66). Wall 6318s.

200M pilot on fir H100 3g.40gb. Structured obs + PopArt. BEST PILOT: avg_return=17.74 at 200M. skeleton 80% zombie 80% iron_sword 8% iron_pickaxe 24%. PopArt stabilizes value learning with gamma=0.999. Wall 8270s (2.3h).
